basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is recruiting candidates for 3 vacancies for Consultant (Admin.), Consultant (Legal), and Consultant (Internal Audit / Finance) posts on a contract basis. The last date for receipt of application is 12 November 2026, and completed offline applications must be sent by speed post or by hand to Shri Hawa Singh, Chief Administrative Officer at JIPMER, Puducherry. Qualifications differ by post, requiring a Graduate in any discipline, with a Bachelor's Degree in Law or equivalent specified for the legal role. Pay is provide

faq.question: Q1. Is the JIPMER Consultant position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a contract basis initially for a period of one year, extendable up to a maximum age of 65 years or for a maximum period of three years, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or extra allowances paid on top of the fixed remuneration?
faq.answer: No HRA shall be paid. Transport allowance is fixed as applicable on the date of engagement and remains unchanged during tenure.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these consultant positions?
faq.answer: Retired government servants from Ministries, Departments, attached or subordinate offices of Central, State, or UT Governments, Autonomous Bodies, Statutory Bodies, or PSUs who have served in pay level 10 and above (as per 7th CPC) along with the required educational qualifications can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for UR, OBC, EWS, SC, ST, and PWD candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500 plus applicable transaction charges for UR/OBC/EWS candidates, ₹250 plus transaction charges for SC/ST candidates, and PWD candidates are exempted.
